conclusion: First real (non-infra-blocked) c-series cycle since c2: grammar_completion_bounds shows a small p50 latency win (-5.41ms) on this size-matched 21-step fixture, but the win is rejected as non-positive because meaningful_program_rate=0.0 on both arms (mpr=0.0 < 0.333333 floor) -- a latency delta with no held quality is not a real win. Ship gates fail honestly on fixture n=3 (insufficient_n, need>=20) plus missing held_out/adversarial/ood/rico_held suites, as expected for a wf_smoke_v2/steps=21 screening cycle. Two attempts before this one failed in this fresh container for setup reasons already documented in README (`pip install -e ".[dev,torch,web]"`, `npm ci`), not harness bugs: (1) the venv had no torch yet (train_model.detect_device import), (2) `npm ci` had not been run yet, so evaluate_model's publish_agentv_evaluation could not find the AgentV SDK. Running the documented setup steps resolved both before re-running the identical cycle spec.
next_priorities: Do not treat a latency-only delta as positive when meaningful_program_rate is 0 on both arms -- current classifier already rejects this correctly (latency_win_rejected_low_mpr); keep that gate.
Re-test grammar_completion_bounds vs control at a larger step budget once a cycle produces meaningful_program_rate > 0, so mpr has signal to gate on.
Do not promote RL; ship gates fail by design on fixture n.
